title: Matchup Brief
description: The objective, shared counterplay annotations for ONE opponent Variant Cluster (ADR-0027). Lives beside the auto-artifact at src/common/scouting/briefs/<slug>.json; authored by /matchup-genie, consumed (future) by the Read/Posture layer to populate Board opponent-property fields. Validated by scripts/validate_brief.py (the enforcing gate; this schema is the human/machine reference).

covers.description: member Archetype strings (from index.json[slug].covers) — routes every variant to this one Brief; the Read matches read.candidates[0] against this list

authored.description: ISO date the Brief was authored/updated

summary.description: one-line objective profile: how it wins + its exploitable seam

tempo.description: the race clock — when it starts taking prizes

opponent_properties.description: the levers — boolean/scalar weakness keys the (future) consumer maps onto Board. Every key must be registered in src/common/scouting/opponent_properties.json.

threats.description: the opponent's attackers we must respect

targets.description: what to disrupt or snipe, using the Dossier role vocab

role.description: MUST equal the matchup-tier half of common/scouting/matchup_plan.ROLE_REGISTRY (Issue #395 D2). Nothing in src/ or tests/ loaded this enum before that issue, and validate_brief.py — which does enforce it — had no automated caller, so a typo'd role shipped green; tests/scouting/test_scouting_matchup_plan.py now asserts this list against the registry.
